This '''individual''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who served the militant faction of the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]], a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization opposed to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].<ref name="cod" /> In [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]],<ref name="tnec" /> the famed [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Arwen Cohl]] led a group of Nebula Front members in infiltrating the ''[[Revenue]]'', a Trade Federation [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class LH-3210 cargo freighter]] that was receiving a shipment of [[Lommite/Legends|lommite ore]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]]. They succeeded in stealing the hidden cargo of [[Aurodium/Legends|aurodium]] ingots; however, the Bothan was the only member of the team to survive and reached the group's rendezvous point, where the Bothan joined the rest of Cohl's team before the ''Revenue '' was destroyed.<ref name="cod" />

The surviving infiltrators boarded a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and hid in the ''Revenue's'' starboard hangar arm for four [[Standard day|days]], avoiding the patrols of the [[Dorvalla Space Corps]]. Judging that enough time has passed, Cohl decided to bring them down to the planet's surface but was intercepted by a [[Picket ship/Legends|picket ship]] belonging to the Corps. After refusing an order to land, the shuttle was fired upon with [[Laser cannon/Legends|lasers]] and crash landed, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the Bothan and the majority of the Nebula Front members.<ref name="cod" />
